name: Palette cycle
doc: Rotates the stops of the input palette (a colour wheel when unconnected) on every beat or bar: jumping in step mode, gliding from one rotation to the next in smooth mode.

stride.doc: stops moved per beat or bar (negative goes backwards)

flash.doc: OKLab lightness lift right after each change

loop.doc: repeat the first stop at the end (palettes under 8 stops), so shaders that wrap along it show no seam
